title_en: Great Poems and Songs (12/20): Yue Fei and "The River Runs Red"
note_en: The 把 construction moves the object in front of the verb to stress what happens to it: 把岳飞害死了 "had Yue Fei killed." The pattern is subject + 把 + object + verb + result, and the verb can't stand bare: it needs something after it, like 死了 here. Compare 把岳飞当作忠诚勇敢的象征, "to regard Yue Fei as a symbol of loyalty and courage."
